## Functions

### directSandbox()

```ts
function directSandbox(callback): Sandbox;
```

Dispatch a known-binding callback directly in this process. NOT isolation:
submitted code is ignored, and the callback retains all host privileges. Use
only trusted tests and examples, never model-authored code execution.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                              |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `callback` | [`DirectSandboxCallback`](#directsandboxcallback) |
